financials_interim.notes: COMPANY (standalone holding-company) basis, Rs.'000. Sunshine Holdings PLC is a pure investment-holding parent -- 'Results from operating activities' (1,722,016) is dominated by Dividend income of Rs.1,764,226 ('000) received from subsidiaries, not by trading revenue (Rs.269,683 '000). tax_expense is a net tax CREDIT/reversal of Rs.1,619 ('000), stored as -1,619 so that profit_before_tax (1,707,927) minus tax_expense equals profit_after_tax (1,709,546), consistent with the validator's PBT - tax = PAT convention. inventory left at 0 (no inventory line at the standalone holding-company level).

GROUP basis, figures in Rs.'000 per the filing. Period is a single quarter (1QFY27, three months ended 30 June 2026), FYE 31 March. operating_profit = disclosed 'Results from operating activities' subtotal (2,440,140); this reconciles with Net finance income/(cost) (+159,693) to PBT (2,599,834). minority_interest = 'Non-controlling interest' profit attribution (741,840) -- unusually large relative to owners' profit (665,366) because the Group's basic EPS (0.34) is computed on owners' profit only (665,366/1,967,894,516 shares = 0.338, ties to the disclosed 0.34); diluted EPS = basic per Note 15 (no dilutive instruments during the period). short_term_borrowings/long_term_borrowings = 'Loans and borrowings' BS lines only; bank overdraft (1,889,641) excluded from borrowings and also excluded from cash_and_equivalents (BS 'Cash & cash equivalent' asset line used as-is, gross of overdraft). capex = Acquisition of PPE only from the cash flow statement; smaller items (bearer plant/livestock additions, intangibles) omitted for consistency with other entries in this DB. total_liabilities (32,552,766) taken directly from the Segmental Analysis note's Group 'Total liabilities' line, which ties to Total assets (59,702,058) less Total equity (27,149,292).

interim_updates.note_text: Sunshine Holdings PLC (SUN) Group revenue grew 16.6% YoY to Rs.18.54bn in 1QFY27 (quarter ended 30 June 2026), driven by the consolidation of Joint Agri Products Ceylon (JAPC, acquired 30 March 2026, effective 75% stake) and organic growth across segments. Gross profit rose only 3.2% to Rs.5.22bn as gross margin compressed 366bps to 28.1% from 31.8%, and EBIT (Results from operating activities) fell 7.8% to Rs.2.44bn from Rs.2.64bn -- margin pressure was concentrated in two areas per the GCEO's letter: NMRA-driven price reductions in Healthcare (pharmaceutical agency business revenue -18.2%) and higher operating costs in Agribusiness (Agribusiness EBIT margin eased to 47.2% from 48.8%). By segment: Healthcare (49.2% of revenue) grew 5.9% to Rs.9.13bn, with medical devices +8.8% and Lina +20.5% offsetting the pharma agency decline; Consumer (35.6% of revenue) grew 38.0% to Rs.6.60bn, almost entirely due to JAPC consolidation (excluding JAPC, Consumer revenue grew only 2.1%), with branded tea +8.3% and confectionery +6.9%; Agribusiness (15.2% of revenue) grew 12.8% to Rs.2.81bn, driven by oil palm revenue +17.9% to Rs.2.5bn on higher prices/volumes, partly offset by dairy revenue -7.1% to Rs.258.9mn. Despite the EBIT decline, PBT fell only 2% to Rs.2.60bn because Net Finance Income swung sharply positive -- Finance income more than doubled to Rs.408.5mn (+172%) against Finance cost of Rs.248.8mn (+79%), a Rs.148.6mn favourable swing in net finance income/(cost) (Rs.159.7mn net income this quarter vs Rs.11.1mn net income a year earlier) that substantially cushioned the EBIT decline. Group PAT still rose 6.0% to Rs.1.41bn, but the split between owners and non-controlling interests moved further toward NCI (Rs.741.8mn NCI vs Rs.665.4mn to owners, roughly 53:47), so basic EPS actually fell 17% to Rs.0.34 from Rs.0.41 despite Group PAT rising -- a reminder that consolidated PAT growth this quarter is not accruing proportionately to Sunshine Holdings PLC shareholders.

interim_updates.takeaway: Group PAT rose 6.0% YoY, but that headline masks two offsetting effects a shareholder should weigh: core operating profitability (EBIT) actually fell 7.8% on margin pressure in Healthcare (NMRA pricing) and Agribusiness (cost inflation, dairy weakness), rescued by a large positive swing in net finance income (+172% finance income); and a growing share of profit is going to non-controlling interests following the JAPC acquisition, so basic EPS attributable to Sunshine Holdings shareholders fell 17% to Rs.0.34 even as consolidated PAT grew.
operational_highlights: Group revenue Rs.18.54bn, up 16.6% YoY, boosted by JAPC consolidation; like-for-like Consumer segment growth (ex-JAPC) was only 2.1%
Gross margin compressed to 28.1% from 31.8% (-366bps); EBIT fell 7.8% YoY to Rs.2.44bn (EBIT margin 13.2% vs 16.6%)
Healthcare segment (49.2% of revenue) revenue +5.9% to Rs.9.13bn: pharma agency business -18.2%, medical devices +8.8%, Lina +20.5%
Consumer segment (35.6% of revenue) revenue +38.0% to Rs.6.60bn (ex-JAPC +2.1%): branded tea +8.3%, confectionery +6.9%, tea exports -6.3%
Agribusiness segment (15.2% of revenue) revenue +12.8% to Rs.2.81bn: oil palm +17.9% to Rs.2.5bn, dairy -7.1% to Rs.258.9mn, EBIT margin down to 47.2% from 48.8%
Net finance income swung to +Rs.159.7mn from +Rs.11.1mn a year earlier (finance income +172% to Rs.408.5mn), which offset most of the EBIT decline at the PBT line
key_drivers: NMRA-driven pharmaceutical price reductions and industry-wide volume constraints cut the pharma agency business by 18.2%, pressuring Healthcare margins despite 5.9% segment revenue growth
JAPC (Cinnamon/spice export) consolidation added ~36 percentage points of Consumer segment revenue growth; excluding it, Consumer grew only 2.1%
Oil palm price and volume gains (+17.9% to Rs.2.5bn) were the main Agribusiness growth driver, while dairy (-7.1%) and higher input costs eroded Agribusiness EBIT margin
A Rs.148.6mn favourable swing in net finance income/(cost) (finance income +172% YoY) offset most of the 7.8% EBIT decline at the PBT line
Rising non-controlling interest share (JAPC minority stake) meant Group PAT (+6.0%) grew faster than owners' profit, causing basic EPS to fall 17% YoY

_gaps: ebitda: depreciation_amortization not disclosed; EBITDA understated (= operating profit only)
